overview_description.description: Founded outside of Washington DC, CircleBack, Inc. is a technology company dedicated to solving a major productivity problem: keeping contact data accurate. Using a patented data engine, CircleBack lets you know when connections change jobs, companies, email addresses, and work numbers, delivering these updates directly to mobile address books and CRMs. This makes it easier than ever for both professionals and businesses to keep connections alive and get stuff done faster and with more accuracy.

about_short_description.short_description: A technology company focused on solving a major productivity problem: keeping contact data accurate.

product.name: CircleBack Contact Management App
product.description: A mobile and web app that manages and updates business contacts by consolidating duplicates and refreshing outdated information.

product.name: Contact Deduplication - CleanUp Duplicate Contacts
product.description: An app that identifies and merges duplicate contacts in address books, offering customizable merge sensitivity and backup features.

product.name: Email Signature Capture Functionality (ContactSaver)
product.description: A feature that extracts contact information from email signature blocks and headers to add new contacts automatically.

product.name: Business Card Scanning
product.description: An OCR-based tool that scans business cards to quickly add contact information to address books.

product.name: Unified Address Book and Sync
product.description: A service that consolidates contacts from multiple networks into a single, synchronized address book accessible across devices.
